name: E2B MCP
tagline: Run code in a secure sandboxed environment from your AI agent.
shortDescription: The official E2B MCP server. Lets your agent execute arbitrary code in a secure, isolated, ephemeral Linux sandbox. Each execution is a fresh container, so it's safe to run untrusted code.
longDescription:
## What it is

The E2B MCP server, by E2B. Exposes the E2B cloud sandbox API as MCP tools: run Python/JavaScript/Bash code, install packages, read files, write files. Each execution runs in a fresh, isolated Linux container that auto-destroys after the session.

## Why we recommend it

The safest way to give an agent the ability to execute code. The sandbox is ephemeral (each session is a fresh container), the network is firewalled, and the filesystem doesn't persist. Your agent can run anything — `pip install`, shell commands, data analysis — without risk to your machine or data.

## When to use it

- Code execution for agents that need to test or run code (instead of just generating it)
- Data analysis: agent runs pandas/sklearn on uploaded files
- One-off scripts: agent runs a quick task without polluting the local env
- Education: agent runs code samples and explains output
installInstructions:
1. Get an API key at https://e2b.dev/dashboard
2. Set `E2B_API_KEY=...`
3. `uvx mcp-server-e2b`

**Pricing note:** E2B charges per second of sandbox runtime. Free tier gives some hours. Pro plans start at $0.10/hour.
pricingDetails: Free. E2B: free tier with limited hours. Pro plans from $0.10/hour.
